skill.name: x-articles
skill.tagline: Publish Markdown documents as long-form X Articles using the official X API
skill.shortSummary: Convert Markdown files to X (Twitter) Articles, upload images, and publish through XMCP.
skill.fullSummary: This skill turns a Markdown file into a published X Article (long-form post) using the official X API v2 Articles endpoints. It deterministically converts Markdown to content_state, uploads images, creates a draft, and only publishes after your explicit approval. A built-in sensitive-information scanner keeps credentials and personal data safe before any content reaches X’s servers.

highlights.title: Sensitive data protection
highlights.description: A deterministic scanner detects credentials, financial figures, and personal data in text and images, ensuring nothing sensitive leaves your machine before you approve or redact it.

highlights.title: Deterministic Markdown conversion
highlights.description: A script converts Markdown to X’s native content_state format, supporting headings, lists, code blocks, tables, links, and embedded posts—with all content degradations reported upfront.

highlights.title: Image upload with media mapping
highlights.description: Images are uploaded via XMCP’s chunked upload API and re‑mapped into the draft; cover images are supported. Remote images are also downloaded and re‑uploaded.

highlights.title: Draft-first, publish‑later
highlights.description: Articles are created as drafts only, giving you full review in the X composer before you decide to publish. There is no update; regenerating creates a new draft.

steps.name: Pre‑flight sensitive scan
steps.description: Scan text and images for credentials, financial data, and personal info before any API call.
steps.details: Run a deterministic scanner on the Markdown file and every referenced image. Show all findings and wait for your decision before proceeding.

steps.name: Convert Markdown to X draft
steps.description: Run the Markdown‑to‑content‑state converter; review reported degradations.
steps.details: Convert headings, bold/italic, links, code blocks, tables, and images. Flattened nested lists, dropped HTML blocks, or heading clamping are surfaced as warnings—never silently lost.

steps.name: Upload images
steps.description: Upload each required image via chunked media upload; build the media map.
steps.details: For each image source, initialize, append, and finalize the upload using XMCP tools, then re‑run the converter with the media map, so `media_id`s are embedded correctly.

steps.name: Create X Article draft
steps.description: Submit the draft via `articleCreateDraft`; review in the X composer.
steps.details: Post the title and content_state (optionally with a cover image). Receive the article ID and editor URL. The draft remains private and can be discarded at any time.

steps.name: Publish on explicit approval
steps.details: Publishing is irreversible. Once you confirm, the API publishes the draft and returns the post ID and public URL for the published Article.
